examples.text: 1912, Martin Luther, Lutherbibel von 1912, Psalm 119:10 (with KJV translation)
examples.translation: With my whole heart have I sought thee; Oh, let me not wander from thy commandments.
examples.english: With my whole heart have I sought thee; Oh, let me not wander from thy commandments.

examples.text: Seine Augen irren ab, sein Blick irrt ab.
examples.translation: Il détourne les yeux, le regard.
Il est perdu dans ses pensées.
